name: GB Auto (GB Corp)
source: GB Corp Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial position and statement of cash flows (EGP thousand, stored absolute)
source_note: Read from the audited consolidated financial statements in the GB Corp Annual Report 2025 (KPMG Hazem Hassan, qualified opinion on one associate, signed 26 Feb 2026), amounts printed in EGP thousand and stored here in absolute EGP. Identities tie to the unit: Non-current plus Current Assets equals Total Assets (37,030,717 + 54,327,968 = 91,358,685); Non-current plus Current Liabilities equals Total Liabilities (14,455,488 + 46,313,042 = 60,768,530); Total Liabilities plus Total Equity equals Total Assets. Cash and Equivalents is the balance sheet line (note 16); the cash flow statement closes at 9,524,009 because it nets overdrafts.
